senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. pl. Rakkath, a fortified town of Naftali.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 6a:4">Meg. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>ר׳ זו ציפורי</he> … <he>כרקתא וכ׳</he> R. is Sepphoris, and its name was Rakkath, because it lies high like the banks of a river.
<cite ref="Megillah 6a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>ר׳ זו טבריא</he> R. is Tiberias.

<cite ref="Megillah 6a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>איכא … ר׳ לאו טבריא היא וכ׳</he> is there any one that can say, R. is not Tiberias? when one dies here (in Babylonia), do they not eulogize him there in (Tiberias): <he>גרול הוא בששך ושם לו בר׳</he> he was great in Sheshakh (Babylonia), and had a name in Rakkath? <cite ref="Megillah 6a:2">Ib.</cite> <he>יושבי ר׳ צאו וכ׳</he> citizens of R., go forth and receive the dead of the valley (Babylonia); a. e.
